sections.title: About JustFlip
content: JustFlip is a technology platform that facilitates the discovery, listing, and exchange of information relating to real estate properties and related services.

Depending on the services available on the Platform, JustFlip may allow users to search and browse residential and commercial properties, view property information, publish or manage property listings, contact property owners or real estate professionals, save properties and search preferences, and access property-related tools and services.
JustFlip may introduce, modify, suspend, or discontinue features or services from time to time.

sections.title: Eligibility
content: You must be at least 18 years old and legally capable of entering into a binding agreement to use the Platform.

By using JustFlip, you represent and warrant that you are at least 18 years of age, that the information you provide is accurate and complete, that you have the legal capacity to enter into these Terms, and that you will use the Platform only for lawful purposes.
If you are using the Platform on behalf of an organization, company, developer, broker, or other entity, you represent that you have the authority to bind that entity to these Terms.

sections.title: Registration and User Accounts
content: Certain features may require you to create an account.
When creating an account, you agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information and to keep that information updated.
You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials, restricting unauthorized access to your account, and all activity conducted through your account.
You must immediately notify JustFlip if you believe your account has been compromised.
You must not create an account using another person's identity or impersonate another person or organization.
JustFlip reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that contain false information, violate these Terms, or are associated with fraudulent, abusive, or unlawful activity.

sections.title: Property Listings
content: Users who publish property listings are responsible for ensuring that all information provided is accurate, complete, current, and not misleading.

A listing may contain information including property type, location, sale or rental price, area, number of bedrooms and bathrooms, parking, amenities, photographs, videos, ownership information, availability, construction status, possession information, and contact information.
You must not publish information that you know, or reasonably should know, to be false, misleading, fraudulent, defamatory, or unlawful.
You must ensure that you have the necessary rights and authority to publish a property listing and any photographs, videos, documents, or other material associated with it.

sections.title: Property Information and Verification
content: JustFlip may display property information submitted by property owners, brokers, developers, agents, users, or third-party sources.

Although JustFlip may use reasonable efforts to identify inaccurate, incomplete, suspicious, or duplicate listings, JustFlip does not guarantee that every listing or property-related statement is accurate, complete, current, or independently verified.
Property prices, availability, specifications, dimensions, amenities, photographs, construction status, possession dates, ownership information, and other details may change without notice.
Users should independently verify important property information and conduct appropriate due diligence before making any financial, contractual, or property-related decision.

sections.title: Property Transactions
content: JustFlip generally acts as a technology and information platform and does not necessarily act as the owner, seller, buyer, landlord, tenant, broker, developer, or legal representative of a property displayed on the Platform.
Unless expressly stated otherwise, JustFlip is not a party to transactions between users.

Any transaction, agreement, negotiation, booking, sale, lease, rental arrangement, token payment, advance payment, or other arrangement entered into between users is undertaken at the users' own discretion and risk.

Users are responsible for independently verifying property ownership, title and encumbrances, approvals and permissions, building and development approvals, RERA registration or applicable regulatory information, taxes and statutory dues, property documents, seller or landlord identity, agreement terms, payment obligations, and possession commitments.
JustFlip does not guarantee that a transaction between users will be completed successfully.

sections.title: Prohibited Activities
content: You must not use JustFlip to publish fraudulent or misleading property listings.
You must not impersonate another person or organization.
You must not publish a property without appropriate authorization.
You must not upload stolen, copyrighted, or unauthorized content.
You must not use the Platform for unlawful activities.
You must not collect or misuse another user's personal information.
You must not send spam or unsolicited commercial communications.
You must not attempt to bypass Platform security measures.
You must not introduce malware, viruses, or other harmful software.
You must not scrape, copy, reproduce, or systematically extract Platform data without authorization.
You must not manipulate listings, reviews, rankings, or other Platform functionality.
You must not create multiple accounts for abusive or fraudulent purposes.
You must not attempt to gain unauthorized access to another user's account.
You must not use automated systems to access the Platform in a manner that violates our technical restrictions.
You must not use the Platform in a manner that could damage, disable, overburden, or impair its operation.
JustFlip may investigate suspected violations and take appropriate action, including removing content, restricting access, suspending accounts, or terminating accounts.

sections.title: User-Generated Content
content: Users may submit photographs, videos, descriptions, reviews, comments, property information, documents, and other content to the Platform.

You retain ownership of your User Content. However, by submitting User Content to JustFlip, you grant JustFlip a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to host, store, reproduce, display, distribute, modify, format, and otherwise use that content as reasonably necessary to operate, maintain, improve, and promote the Platform.

You represent that you own or have the necessary rights to submit the content, that the content does not violate applicable law, that the content does not infringe another person's rights, and that the content is not fraudulent, defamatory, abusive, or misleading.
JustFlip may remove or restrict access to User Content that violates these Terms or applicable law.

sections.title: Photographs, Videos, and Property Media
content: If you upload photographs, videos, floor plans, documents, or other media relating to a property, you confirm that you have the necessary rights or authorization to use and publish that material.

You must not upload media that belongs to another person without permission, contains unlawful or prohibited material, misrepresents the property, intentionally conceals material defects or important information, or violates another person's privacy.
JustFlip may resize, compress, crop, format, or otherwise technically modify uploaded media for Platform functionality and presentation.

sections.title: Communications
content: By using the Platform or providing your contact information, you may receive communications relating to account activity, property enquiries, listing activity, service updates, security notifications, customer support, transaction-related information, and other communications associated with your use of JustFlip.
Where required by applicable law, promotional communications will be subject to applicable consent and opt-out requirements.
You are responsible for ensuring that the contact information associated with your account remains accurate.

sections.title: Third-Party Services and Links
content: The Platform may contain links, integrations, advertisements, maps, payment services, analytics tools, communication services, or other features provided by third parties.
Third-party services may operate under their own terms and privacy policies.
JustFlip does not necessarily control or endorse third-party services and is not responsible for their availability, accuracy, security, content, policies, or practices.
Your use of third-party services is subject to the applicable third party's terms.

sections.title: Maps and Location Information
content: Certain features of JustFlip may use maps, geographical coordinates, nearby places, location searches, or other location-based information.
Location information displayed through the Platform may be obtained from third-party mapping or data providers and may not always be completely accurate or current.
Distances, boundaries, routes, nearby places, travel times, and other geographical information should be treated as approximate unless expressly stated otherwise.
Users should independently verify important location-related information before making property or financial decisions.

sections.title: Pricing and Financial Information
content: Property prices, rental amounts, maintenance charges, taxes, fees, loan estimates, EMI calculations, and other financial information displayed on JustFlip may be provided by users, third parties, or generated using assumptions and publicly available information.
Such information is provided for general informational purposes and should not be treated as financial, investment, tax, legal, or professional advice.
Any calculator or estimate provided by JustFlip may not account for every applicable charge, tax, interest rate, processing fee, or individual financial circumstance.
You should consult an appropriately qualified professional before making significant financial decisions.

Except as expressly permitted by JustFlip, you must not copy or reproduce substantial portions of the Platform, modify or create derivative works, distribute Platform content for commercial purposes, reverse engineer or attempt to extract source code, remove copyright or proprietary notices, or use JustFlip trademarks or branding without authorization.

The Privacy Policy explains how JustFlip may collect, use, store, process, and protect personal information.

Access may occasionally be interrupted because of maintenance, software updates, infrastructure failures, network issues, third-party service failures, security incidents, or events beyond our reasonable control.

JustFlip does not guarantee that property listings will always be accurate or available, that information will always be complete or current, that the Platform will operate without interruption, that errors will always be corrected, or that the Platform will meet every user's particular requirements.
JustFlip does not guarantee that property transactions will be completed successfully, that a property will meet a user's expectations, or that third-party services will remain available or accurate.
Users should conduct their own independent verification and due diligence before relying on property or transaction-related information.

When reporting an issue, provide as much relevant information and supporting evidence as reasonably possible.
